summary: Some container hosts need a systemd cgroup mount before ansible-test containers work; ansible-test prints the commands. Rootless Podman also needs a chown, and it must be redone after each host boot.
questions: ansible-test says I need to mount a cgroup, what do I run?
How do I use ansible-test with rootless Podman?
Why does my cgroup fix disappear after reboot?

answer_card.title: Fix cgroup errors for ansible-test containers
answer_card.answer_md:
When ansible-test reports a cgroup error, run as root (again after every host reboot):
```shell
mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd
mount cgroup -t cgroup /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd -o none,name=systemd,xattr
```
For rootless Podman, also run as root:
```shell
chown -R {user}:{group} /sys/fs/cgroup/systemd
```
